verdict.rationale: OCI documents official getting-started tutorials, such as launching an instance and building a load balancer, and shows exact CLI install commands. Cloud Shell also provides a pre-configured CLI, which shortens setup. The evidence does not show a zero-to-running-service quickstart with the exact deploy commands, or any measure of first deploy taking under an hour. Missing for 10: an end-to-end quickstart with verbatim deploy commands for a running service, evidence of time-to-first-deploy under an hour, and independent hands-on corroboration of the onboarding path.

support.subject: As a developer, first deploy is under an hour — official quickstarts that go from zero to a running service with the exact commands shown
